Overview.Name: Jampani Swathi Manaswini
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & mixed vegetable curry + paneer cubes (120 g)
Meal_2 (Dinner - light): Option 1: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + cooked vegetables
Option 3: Vegetable soup + paneer cubes (80 g)

Notes_and_Tips: Keep sweets and bakery foods minimal to support PCOS recovery.
Start meals with paneer or curd before eating rice.
Keep dinner lighter and avoid eating very late at night.
Stress can worsen cravings and hormonal imbalance, so maintain fixed meal timings.
Consistent yoga, sleep and simple meals will improve energy and hormonal balance.
